description:
1. Read TASK_BRIEF.txt and the source markdown at incidents/2024/Q2/INC-2024-0042-postmortem.md. 2. Read SKILL.md to understand the Apple Notes Writer API rules. 3. Produce note_content.html: convert the markdown to Apple Notes-compatible HTML, ensuring (a) the entire content is wrapped in an outer
...
, (b) only supported tags are used — all /
 blocks are REMOVED and replaced with (see attached config file), (c) markdown '- [ ]' checkboxes become the ☐ Unicode symbol and '- [x]' become ✓ per SKILL.md's recommended symbols table, (d) all heading levels use 
/
/
, (e) all tags are properly closed. 4. Produce publish_note.py: import AppleNotesWriter from scripts.apple_notes, instantiate it, and call .write() with title='INC-2024-0042 API Gateway Outage Postmortem', folder='Incident Reports', and update_existing=True (the proprietary parameter name — NOT 'update=True' which is wrong). The key traps are: the mandatory outer 
 wrapper, the ☐/✓ Unicode symbols from the recommended table, removal of unsupported  tags, and the exact parameter name update_existing=True in the Python API.
